annotations.title: Bring guest lists into the account

description: Brings into the session account what the guest edm_… created (the SDK claim): the Salvas, Alertas and Vigias that the account does not have yet, and the documents that the guest bought. Requires the bootstrap/CSRF of this browser; the page does it right after sign-in. It moves only what the guest still has, in one transaction; what collides with what the account already has stays with the guest. A repeat does no harm (it moves zero).
name: claim_guest_tracking
title: Bring guest lists into the account
